title: Founding of Sicyon in Greece
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2 · CFAH non-anchor dates: 2089 or 2076 BC (CFAH-2). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was provisional (Generations) 2089 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 2: Founding of the Nations," ARJ 15 (2022): 405–426, section "Duration 14: The Founding of Sicyon: 2089 or 2076 BC"
chronologies.note: Two counts: Eusebius (via Ussher) gives 1,313 years before the first Olympiad, which is 2089 BC. Not an anchor point (tier 2, CFAH non-anchor date).

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 6 "The Dispersion and the Descent into Darkness", PDF p. 127 (printed p. 113)
chronologies.note: After Ussher citing Eusebius. p. 158 prints "2085 BC".
